steps.message: Give me the five most important things to focus on today, with evidence and any decisions I need to make.

reply.answer:
Five things for today (data as of 2026-04-01): 12 unfinished orders need attention — 8 overdue, 3 due within 3 days, 1 idle 7+ days. Below are the top five, each with its evidence and the call to make.

1. **ORD-107 — Northwind Apparel, 2000 pcs, at PACKING, due 2026-03-16, 16 days late.** Last activity 2026-04-01 — the earliest date, not a past date, so it's not currently idle. Decision: confirm whether packing really is in hand today and whether Northwind needs a revised date. (orders.csv row 81)

2. **ASSEMBLY output down 29.3%** — last 3 workdays averaged 432 pcs/day vs 611 over the 7 before; yesterday alone was 455, 11.8% under its 7-workday average. Other stages were within 3.6%. Decision: verify the records and decide whether to rebalance assembly capacity. The data cannot say why it dropped. (production_log.csv rows 315–359)

3. **ORD-120 — TrendCart, 1500 pcs, at ASSEMBLY, due 2026-03-17, 15 days late** (last activity 2026-03-30). Decision: decide whether to chase TrendCart and whether it waits behind the assembly slump in #2. (orders.csv row 76)

4. **ORD-114 — Northwind Apparel, 2000 pcs, at PACKING, due 2026-03-23, 9 days late.** Together with ORD-107 this is two large Northwind orders late — a customer-level conversation may be worth having once you've checked both. (orders.csv row 85)

5. **Maple & Co slipping: both open orders late — ORD-083 (1000 pcs, WASHING, due 2026-03-23, 9 days late) and ORD-093 (100 pcs, WASHING, due 2026-03-29, 3 days late).** Decision: review both before contacting the customer. (orders.csv rows 88, 99)

Two watch items where a decision is still avoidable: ORD-005 (TrendCart, KNITTING) has no recorded activity for 8 days, and ORD-029 (Northwind, 1500 pcs) is due today and still at WASHING.
